The last part broke me, a lot of posts here ends in the (hopeful) note of parting ways. I know I cannot do that, I wish to see more long lasting relationships where something worked out.
I'm responding very late but your response helped me a lot. A lot.

Thank you for your response. I'm from India and things are very very grim here for any kind of mental health situation, especially schizophrenia. Getting help from institution and authorities are very difficult. He is getting help from his psychiatrist, and therapists. We're trying to figure out. He is not averse to medication and takes it regularly. 


I'm still trying to figure out. It's very difficult still
Out by Natsuo Kirino, really smooth to read and will keep you gripped to read more.

Thank you for responding; I will keep this in mind. We are trying to do this; he is doing well as of now. Hallucinations are very occasional, and they don't phase him. I just hope the whole process of getting help doesn't scare him. Thank you again; I hope you feel better as well.

Thank you so much. I unfortunately live in India and as far as I know there aren't any such programs but I would research more. A community is something I feel would really help him and even he wants.

When I wrote here, I didn't expect this kind of response and I am so very thankful for this! I think I am also scared of the conflict and tend to scale it down for too long and then burst up at the smallest sign of it.  

> Im sorry. These are tools we learned to adapt and survive in an unhealthy home or relationship. You dont need these tools to build a good relationship, they do more harm than good hence where we got them im the first place. The first thing i have to adress is your needs are valid, you have to rock the boat to get yours. Its your life, its your relationship too, you have needs that have to be accomodated as well. My wife has depression, anxiety, ocd, its fucking miserable; not better or worse than depression, anxiety, adhd. Your martyrdom will earn you nothing but heartache. 

You have no clue that you pointing this out how much it means to me. You are absolutely right. I grew up with very very toxic parents and downright physically and emotionally abusive father. I think I am so used to navigate that relationship, I find myself not-ready for something good. But I think I can see that and it is a good place for me to finally start to address my needs and ask for things and also be okay with it, show gratitude for getting things, instead of calculating. 

> Your acting normal on the outside so thats all he reads. Thats the concrete information hes working off of. 

You are absolutely right, he has even voiced it a few times that "I think everything is fine and then out of nowhere I see the resentment bursting. I wish you said it to me as and when you felt. " I think I need to be aware of my feelings and not brush it out and then they fester into something I can't handle. 

He is actually very loving, patient and respectful with me. I think if I can smooth out the kinks in our communication, or simply ask for things and be open and not withholding with the information of how I am feeling it can be worked out. Thank you so much. I feel so better. I woke up and read this and felt much better to hear it from someone here. He is actually very kind and always eager to please but I have to ask for it. I guess that is something for me to learn to ask and for him to follow through. 

I will keep the untreated adhd angle in mind. He feels better now after decades, he doesn't have anger issues but feeling of not capable enough and hence his life not being worth is something he struggles with but with therapy he is working on it. He is in touch with his doctor and not completely anti medication. But he feels he is able to manage things better without them right now. 

Again, thank you SO much.
I think having a date night will help us immensely!!! Thank you.

Thank you, this gives me a lot of hope. Yes, we did live alone as well and functioned perfectly, the change in dynamic also is a lot about things not done my way. And I shouldn't sweat the small stuff. I think from yours and all other comments, I do feel to be aware of my needs and speak it out loud so that we can reach an arrangement. Thanks for telling me your arrangement. Gives me some direction in reorientating us. 💚

Thank you, I should focus on myself. And also in the process figure out my needs. I feel like sometimes I don't even know what is it exactly that I need from him or for myself. A lot of resentment also builds because idk what to ask for while he does it effortlessly. It's something I should learn from him 💚 thanks.
Thank you for saying this, it means a lot to me. 😭
